extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: Boundary cap neural crest stem cells were printed in gelatin crosslinked with transglutaminase to work toward spinal cord organoids. 12% gelatin with 25 mg/mL transglutaminase printed well and supported survival and differentiation.

formulations.review_notes: Species of the boundary cap cells not captured (dissected from dorsal root ganglia). No absolute viability percentage.
formulations.name: 12% gelatin + 25 mg/mL transglutaminase
formulations.composition_detail: 12% gelatin crosslinked with 25 mg/mL microbial transglutaminase, with laminin
formulations.cell_type: boundary cap neural crest stem cells
formulations.key_outcome: 12% gelatin/mTG gave good gelation and printability and the largest rise in viable cells from day 1 to 3.

evidence.quote: we selected a mixture of 12% gelatin with 25 mg/mL mTG for 3D printing of three-layered structures
Three sets of scaffolds with 1, 3 and 5 layers were prepared with a BIO X syringe pump printhead (CELLINK AB, Gothenburg, Sweden)
